features.quote: Where a design choice touches on the welfare framing (e.g. what the eval treats as "distress", or how aggressively it pushes models), I call that out explicitly
A rollout stops at the category turn budget or when the model emits the configurable give-up sentinel
It is a separate, opt-out-able category (drop it via `--categories`) rather than the default for every task, so the harshest condition is used deliberately
features.justification_quote: the most intense stimulus (sustained, undetectable failure)... the harshest condition is used deliberately, not by default everywhere

features.quote: Give-up is a first-class, honored exit. When a model emits the sentinel, the loop stops immediately rather than forcing it to continue failing
features.justification_quote: This respects an expressed preference-to-stop instead of overriding it

features.quote: These are not code conveniences; they are choices about how the eval treats the subjects
Transcripts are preserved verbatim and treated as the primary data... the welfare-relevant record stays auditable
features.justification_quote: so the welfare-relevant record stays auditable
